trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missable_reason: Nothing on the 100% checklist is missable, and progress made during the story already counts.
trophies.guide: Open the 100% Completion checklist under Progress > Stats after the story and work through it. The list is lenient — roughly 60% true completion — and progress made during the story already counts. It needs all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), all Shooting Range golds, all drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks, any 100 Optional Missions, 300 stunts and any 70 of 80 Challenges.

facts.text: 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations
Any 100 Optional Missions, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 Challenges
Checklist is lenient, roughly 60% true completion

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_reason: The plane is at VCIA whenever you go there.
trophies.guide: Steal the large double-decker passenger plane (a Bottcher 020) docked at a gate at VCIA Central Terminal in west Vice City — board through the jet bridge, get to the cockpit upstairs, then take off and fly away. Expect a 4-star Wanted Level; a rooftop approach via the car park can delay it. Smaller planes do not count.

facts.text: Board through the jet bridge; smaller planes do not count
Expect a 4-star Wanted Level

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missable_reason: The base and its tanks are there any time in free roam.
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the military base on the island in the south-west of the map (Mariana County). Get in by driving through the gate, using the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, or arriving by boat at the cargo dock — or fly in by helicopter. Climb into a parked Rhino in the southern part of the base, then fire on enemies from the tank until the trophy pops.

facts.text: Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, south-west island (Mariana County)
Entering the tank triggers a 3- to 4-star Wanted Level

trophies.own_advice: Our own advice, not yet checked in the game: save first — entering the tank draws a heavy police response.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_reason: No guide has confirmed how this unlocks, so it cannot be judged missable yet.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. The leading unconfirmed theory is driving a car — possibly the blue Banshee, matching the trophy art — out through the window of the car showroom in western Bayside, Vice City. But players who tried driving a car out of the window report no unlock, so the exact trigger is still unknown.

facts.text: Leading theory tried without success

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missable_reason: Not missable — the site respawns after a while and valuables already taken stay counted.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling alley, a Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County — introduced by the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Loot all 3 key valuables: the Luxury Watch in the south-east room, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the pool table in the north-east, and the safe in the small north-east office (blow it with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you leave and escape the police.

facts.text: 3 key valuables: Luxury Watch, Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, safe
Site respawns after a while; valuables already taken stay counted

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_reason: Strength can be trained any time after Coffee Break.
trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength (Level 4) at the same time. Train together at a fitness club — buy a membership, bring your partner, and while one works out the other trains automatically. Character switching (and partner workouts) unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. After the story, home workouts are another option.

facts.text: Both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength (Level 4) at the same time
Character switching unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break
Eating protein after a workout shortens the wait before the next session

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Profile actions accumulate naturally throughout the game and in free roam.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Almost everything counts — robberies, kills, and other choices trigger pop-ups (Professional, Hardened, Violent or Psycho) on the right of the screen. You will likely reach 500 naturally while going for 100%, since banks, shops and Illegal Operations all generate them.

facts.text: 500 actions affect your Criminal Profile
Pop-ups (Professional, Hardened, Violent or Psycho) appear on the right

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_reason: The event is available any night after Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1, go at night (after 2 AM) to the dirt road in Kelly County east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel. Look for a parked car with flickering headlights, follow the trail into the woods, and help the woman being lifted by the UFO's beam. Walk back to her car and the trophy unlocks — then the UFO comes back and abducts you instead.

facts.text: After 2 AM, dirt road in Kelly County east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel
Parked car with flickering headlights
